title: HSK2 Gate 12 · Tang Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 12: Tang Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第12关：唐朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 一千三百多年以前，中国有一个很大的朝代，叫唐朝。唐朝最大的城叫长安。那时候，它是世界上最大的城。城里住了一百多万人。
passageEn: More than thirteen hundred years ago China had a great dynasty called the Tang. The Tang’s greatest city was Chang’an. At that time it was the largest city in the world. More than a million people lived in it.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: More than thirteen hundred years ago China had a great dynasty called the Tang.
comprehension.answer: 一千三百多年以前，中国有一个很大的朝代，叫唐朝。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: At that time it was the largest city in the world.
comprehension.answer: 那时候，它是世界上最大的城。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 一 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“一”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 一 (yī) means "one" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “一”（yī）的意思是“one”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 千 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“千”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 千 (qiān) means "thousand" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “千”（qiān）的意思是“thousand”，就在上面的短文里。

options.text: Because there was so much rain, the water rose higher and higher.
The water came into the fields, and into many people’s homes.
More than thirteen hundred years ago China had a great dynasty called the Tang.
Very long ago, it rained in China for many days.

speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说唐朝。
